thread:
alex_k: Quick sync — need a decision on the chat completions surface for Dedicated launch. Customers keep asking: messages[] (roles) vs single prompt+system param. @maria_r can you list the top customer asks?

maria_r: Short version — they want stable system instructions, explicit assistant role outputs (for tool routing), and a straightforward way to include tool messages. Most existing agent frameworks expect messages[].

sahil: From infra: messages[] is easier for routing and per-role telemetry. If we keep prompt+system we end up doing a lot of server-side rewriting which complicates caching.

emily_w: Open question — do we allow arbitrary role strings? Customers building agents want 'tool' or 'agent_system' sometimes. If we restrict too much we force transforms.

jordan_p: Proposal: primary API is messages[] with required roles limited to system|user|assistant|tool. Support a legacy 'prompt' param as a compatibility alias for single-user prompt (deprecated 6 months after launch).

maria_r: Launch criteria (high-level): docs + SDK examples, migration guide, acceptance tests for role-driven behavior, one pilot customer (Acme) onboarded, and e2e perf within SLOs.

alex_k: Scope negotiation: v1 = flat messages[], no nested blocks, no role metadata beyond role/name/content. No structured-output validation in v1. Keep it small to ship.

sahil: Implementation notes: normalize and hash system messages separately for prefix caching. Add per-role token accounting in telemetry. We need KV cache changes to support role-segmented keys.

deploy-bot: deploy: feature branch merged -> staging flag -> canary 10% -> monitor logs/latency for 24h.

emily_w: Deliverables checklist: API spec doc, py/ts SDK updates, prompt->messages migration helper, server validation errors, telemetry dashboard showing role latencies and cache hit rate.

jordan_p: Decision ask: please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to messages[] primary + compatibility prompt param, :thumbsdown: if not.

alex_k: :thumbsup: moving to RFC draft.

maria_r: I'll draft the RFC by EOD Friday, include launch criteria and migration notes.

sahil: I'll enumerate infra changes and perf targets and post as a follow-up comment.
